_comment: Pennyroyal Flash-Next DFlash2 fixed width routing: pass this file as --speculative-adaptive-config.
Keys are batch-size floors and candidate_steps are speculative_num_steps; at topk=1 a width's
verify block is steps+1, so a single-request decode batch drafts block6 and every batch of two or
more drafts block4. This is concurrency routing, not acceptance-driven adaptation: one candidate
per tier means the width is a lookup on the batch size and the acceptance EMA can never move it
(a DFLASH tier with two candidates is refused, not silently averaged). No hold/backoff keys are
needed or honoured for the same reason.
Launch for it: --speculative-num-steps 5 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 6 (a routed width above the
launch width is refused, not resized, under captured graphs) and a BS1 bucket in the decode capture
list, which the spec-decode default keeps while max-running-requests >= 1.
